name: Sentinel Luciel Starwhisper
summary: Sentinel Luciel Starwhisper is a night elf scout stationed deep inside enemy territory near the Warsong Lumber Camp in Ashenvale. Operating covertly right at the edge of the Horde's logging operations, she works tirelessly to disrupt the Warsong clan's destruction of the sacred ancient forest.

sections.title: Eyes on the Lumber Camp
sections.body: While most Sentinels hold defensive perimeters at Silverwind Refuge or Astranaar, Luciel Starwhisper conducts forward reconnaissance directly adjacent to the Warsong Lumber Camp. The encroaching orcs have heavily deforested southern Ashenvale, utilizing iron shredders and explosive devices to fell ancient trees. Luciel observes these devastating operations from the brush, directing capable Alliance scouts and adventurers to dismantle Horde machinery, defuse ordnance, and eliminate the engineers driving the deforestation.

faq.answer: Luciel Starwhisper is a night elf Sentinel operating as a field scout near the Warsong Lumber Camp in southern Ashenvale. She monitors Horde logging operations and recruits Alliance allies to actively sabotage Warsong machinery and explosives.

faq.q: Why is she stationed so close to the Warsong Lumber Camp?
faq.answer: Her post provides critical forward observation on the Warsong clan's harvest operations. From her vantage point, she can spot incoming machinery and supply stockpiles, coordinating strikes before the orcs clear deeper into Ashenvale's sacred groves.

faq.q: Is she related to anyone else in Kalimdor?
faq.answer: She shares her surname with Jenai Starwhisper, an astronomer of Darnassus, suggesting she belongs to the Starwhisper lineage, though she chose the path of the martial Sentinels rather than peaceful study.

angles.text: For the kaldorei, Luciel stands on the front line of an existential battle to preserve the sacred boughs of Ashenvale from the axes of the Warsong Outriders.
Alliance operatives moving through contested territory can assist Luciel to blunt the Horde's industrial supply lines in central Kalimdor.
